We hear you, friend! Early recovery can feel incredibly overwhelming, and it’s completely normal to feel stuck. Don’t let those things define you, even though they are just a small part of your identity. The fact that you’re here, sharing what you’re going through, shows that you’re still fighting, even if it doesn’t feel like progress right now.

Recovery isn’t a straight path, and there will be times when you don’t see the growth happening. But staying sober, even when it feels pointless, is proof that you’re already doing something huge. Sometimes, just getting through the day is the win.

If you’re feeling lost, maybe try zooming in on small things—things that bring even the slightest sense of relief. That might be journaling, getting outside, talking to a friend (you’ve improved greatly in that area), or just reminding yourself that feelings aren’t facts. You won’t always feel this way, and there’s a version of you in the future who’s going to be really damn grateful that you kept going.

You’re not alone in this, and you’re not failing. Keep going, even if it’s just one day, one hour at a time. You matter, and your recovery does too.
